name: Royal Red
source:
A century ago, red magic destroyed the world. Now, you wield that same power – and you'll need help to survive.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一个世纪以前，红色魔法毁灭了世界。如今，你掌握了同样的力量——而你要活下去，就得有人帮忙。
